title: Tax break for Fordham Bedford affordable housing, Bronx
summary: This resolution approves a property tax exemption for affordable housing properties in the Fordham Bedford Cluster Phase 3 project in the Bronx, covering parcels in Community Districts 5 and 7. The exemption runs for up to six years from June 23, 2021 under the Private Housing Finance Law, as long as the housing development fund company owner keeps following affordability and regulatory requirements. It applies only to existing buildings on the site and does not refund taxes already paid.
